projects.title: Mental Health Summarization
projects.problem: Counseling dialogues are lengthy and difficult to summarize efficiently
projects.approach: Built and evaluated an NLP model to generate concise summaries of counseling dialogues, using BLEU and BERT scores to benchmark model performance.

projects.title: Speaker-Source Separation
projects.problem: Isolating individual speakers from mixed audio signals
projects.approach: Developed an end-to-end machine learning pipeline for speaker source separation by applying signal-processing methods to isolate signal from noise.

projects.title: Stress Detection
projects.problem: Classifying stress levels from Heart Rate Variability (HRV) data
projects.approach: Built a supervised learning pipeline to classify Stress/No-Stress from HRV data, including feature engineering, model selection, and cross-validation to maximize predictive accuracy.

projects.title: Bid Smart
projects.problem: Optimizing fantasy football team selection using historical data
projects.approach: Designed a data-driven recommendation tool to suggest optimal player picks for a fantasy football team using historical performance data and rule-based scoring logic.
